### Savers Value Village, Inc. Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results To Be Released Thursday, November 5, 2026


October 22, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/614174375/files/doc_news/Savers-Value-Village-Inc--Third-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results-To-Be-Released-Thursday-November-5-2026-2026.pdf)


BELLEVUE, Wash.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Savers Value Village, Inc. (the “Company”) today announced that it plans to report its third quarter financial results on November 5, 2026 after market close. On the same day, the Company will host a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET to discuss its financial results.


Investors and analysts who wish to participate in the call are invited to dial +1 833 461 5787 (international callers, please dial +1 585 542 9983) approximately 10 minutes prior to the start of the call. Please reference Conference ID 419483389 when prompted. A live webcast of the conference call will be available in the investor relations section of the Company’s website,[Savers Value Village - Investor Relations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.savers.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54627361&newsitemid=20261022232530&lan=en-US&anchor=Savers+Value+Village+-+Investor+Relations&index=1&md5=bc45e40c232f9815b1db5a8be56ccbc6) .


A recorded replay of the call will be available on our website shortly after the conclusion of the call and remain available on our website until November 5, 2027.


**About the Savers® Value Village® family of thrift stores**


As the largest for-profit thrift operator in the United States and Canada for value priced pre-owned clothing, accessories and household goods, our mission is to champion reuse and inspire a future where secondhand is second nature. Learn more about the Savers Value Village family of thrift stores, our impact, and the #ThriftProud movement at[savers.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fsavers.com%2F&esheet=54627361&newsitemid=20261022232530&lan=en-US&anchor=savers.com&index=2&md5=21ddd59abe8223d70990dce942371b9d) .
